segments.source: \epigraph{1. Have something to say.\\2. Say it.\\3. Stop when you have said it.\\4. Give the paper a proper title.}{John Shaw Billings, “An Address on Our Medical Literature”,\\International Medical Congress, London (1881)}
segments.translation: \epigraph{1. 할 말이 있어야 합니다.\\2. 그 말을 하십시오.\\3. 다 말했으면 멈추십시오.\\4. 논문에 알맞은 제목을 붙이십시오.}{John Shaw Billings, “An Address on Our Medical Literature”,\\International Medical Congress, London (1881)}

segments.source: \epigraph{You know, I could write a book.\\And this book would be thick enough to stun an ox.}{Laurie Anderson, “Let X=X”, \textit{Big Science} (1982)}
segments.translation: \epigraph{있잖습니까, 저는 책을 한 권 쓸 수도 있습니다.\\그리고 그 책은 황소도 기절시킬 만큼 두꺼울 것입니다.}{로리 앤더슨(Laurie Anderson), “Let X=X”, \textit{Big Science} (1982)}

segments.source: This book was edited in TeXShop (version 4.27) and typeset with pdf\LaTeX{} (MacTeX-2018) using the \texttt{memoir} document class (with \texttt{madsen} chapter style, \texttt{komalike} head style, and \texttt{Ruled} page style); several standard packages including \texttt{amsmath}, \texttt{babel}, \texttt{enumitem}, \texttt{imakeidx}, \texttt{mathdesign}, \texttt{microtype}, and \texttt{standalone}; and an embarrassing amount of customization and \TeX-h\raisebox{-0.5ex}{A}Xing. The text is typeset in Bitstream Charter, {\fontspec{GFSArtemisia}[Extension=.otf]᾿Αρτεμισία}, \textsf{Roboto}, and \texttt{Inconsolata}. Except as indicated in the Image Credits, all figures were drawn by the author using OmniGraffle Pro, exported at PDF files, and included using the \texttt{graphicx} \LaTeX{} package.
segments.translation: 이 책은 TeXShop(버전 4.27)으로 편집했으며, pdf\LaTeX{}(MacTeX-2018)로 조판했습니다. 조판에는 \texttt{memoir} 문서 클래스(\texttt{madsen} 장 스타일, \texttt{komalike} 머리글 스타일, \texttt{Ruled} 페이지 스타일 적용), \texttt{amsmath}, \texttt{babel}, \texttt{enumitem}, \texttt{imakeidx}, \texttt{mathdesign}, \texttt{microtype}, \texttt{standalone}을 비롯한 여러 표준 패키지, 그리고 부끄러울 만큼 많은 사용자 정의와 \TeX-h\raisebox{-0.5ex}{A}Xing을 사용했습니다. 본문은 Bitstream Charter, {\fontspec{GFSArtemisia}[Extension=.otf]᾿Αρτεμισία}, \textsf{Roboto}, \texttt{Inconsolata} 서체로 조판했습니다. 이미지 출처에 따로 밝힌 경우를 제외하면, 모든 그림은 저자가 OmniGraffle Pro로 직접 그려 PDF 파일로 내보낸 뒤 \texttt{graphicx} \LaTeX{} 패키지를 사용하여 삽입했습니다.

segments.source: Portions of our programming have been mechanically reproduced, and we now conclude our broadcast day.
segments.translation: 저희 프로그램의 일부는 기계적으로 복제된 것이며, 이것으로 오늘 방송을 모두 마칩니다.
